segments.mil7.5.3:1.1: “Bhante nāgasena, ‘undūrassa [undurassa (syā. ka.)] ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabba’nti yaṃ vadesi, katamaṃ taṃ ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabba”nti?
segments.mil7.5.3:1.2: “Yathā, mahārāja, undūro itocito ca vicaranto āhārūpāsīsako yeva carati,
segments.mil7.5.3:1.3: evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena itocito ca vicarantena yoniso manasikārūpāsīsakeneva bhavitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.5.3:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, undūrassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
